Real private source approval is sealed/imported by the authenticated analysis service as the actual operational action after deploy, with analysis paused. Future original100 candidates without genuine independent support remain explicitly inconclusive and use the same generic import/recovery path.

Authenticated import checks the same final knowledgeReadiness used by the analysis runtime before creating any review or selection. Evidence-gate acceptance alone is insufficient; unexplained technical gaps remain rejected without an immutable selection.

Preserve all three failure points, detached double-fork coverage, the exact ESRCH and no_children assertions, and the unchanged production supervisor/executor. This fixes a statically demonstrated readiness race; the failed main CI did not record PID 0. Verify only in GitHub Actions as a direct dependency of this same delivery.
